part.content: {"reply":{"text":"Thank you for contacting us. We’re sorry to hear about the flickering and heat. Please cut the power and check the controller plug. If the flicker returns, the controller will be replaced under warranty. If the controller is hot, unplug the strip immediately and do not turn it on until it has been inspected. As a result, we are issuing a store credit of €15. The credit will be applied shortly.","citations":[{"chunk_id":"kb_strip0flck","quote":"If a Flow strip flickers near the controller, cut the power and check the controller plug. If the flicker comes back, the controller is replaced under warranty."},{"chunk_id":"kb_ctrlheat01","quote":"If the controller body is hot to the touch, unplug the strip at once and do not switch it on until it has been checked."}]} }
